title: SuperUltraMegaCraft
description: A fairly simple mod adding several new unique features.
body:
![The main title screen for SuperUltraMegaCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cedef924d844456ec4aeb77010a0f1f01cb28b06.png)


This is a fairy simple mod with several new features. These features include:

- SPOOKY JOOKY
- 6 NEW STRUCTURES
- NEW ORE (Gayite)
- 2 NEW MUSIC DISCS
- 10 NEW BLOCKS
- BOSSFIGHT VS THE DEVELOPER

Note: This mod is in very early Beta. There will be an update soon.
